description: A graded item as Aeroz holds it: grader, cert, grade, identity, whether the grader's own record matched, how many times it has been verified by tap, and its full provenance chain (sealed, sold, consigned, vaulted, shipped, verified…). Use for "is this slab the one that was sealed", "where has it been", "has anyone tried to pass off a copy". Report what this proves AND what it does not.
name: graded_item
